studentDrawer.inactiveBody: Deactivated by {name} on {date}. Reason: {reason}. Sign-in and product access are blocked; subscriptions keep billing.
studentDrawer.readOnly: View only. Your role can see this student but not change it.
studentDrawer.loadError: Student details could not be loaded.
studentDrawer.discardBody: Your Learning Access changes have not been saved.

studentModal.reasonPlaceholder: What happened and the support reference
studentModal.deactivateBody: They will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in by email, Google or WeChat until activated. Their data and Learning Access overrides are kept.
studentModal.deactivateBilling: Billing is not affected. Subscriptions keep renewing; cancel or refund in Stripe if needed.
studentModal.activateBody: Sign-in and product access are restored. Saved overrides apply again. This does not verify the email or change subscriptions.
studentModal.emailStandard: A verification link is sent to the new email; it stays Pending verification until used. Both addresses are told. The student is signed out.
studentModal.emailExemptWarn: This records a staff attestation, not a click by the student. It is logged as a security event.
studentModal.passwordResetBody: The student gets a single-use link that expires. Using it replaces the current password and signs out other sessions.
studentModal.passwordSetupBody: This account has no password yet. The link lets the student create one for email sign-in; Google or WeChat stays linked.
studentModal.resendBody: A new verification link goes to {email}. Earlier links stop working.

studentNotice.change_email_unsent: Email changed, but the verification email was not delivered. Use Resend Verification Email.

studentError.STUDENTS_NOT_CONNECTED: Student Management is not connected to Portal yet.
studentError.STUDENTS_UNAVAILABLE: Portal did not answer. Try again.
studentError.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this just now. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
studentError.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email belongs to another account. Accounts are never merged here; use the account recovery process.
studentError.EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: The email must be verified or Admin-exempt first.
studentError.RATE_LIMITED: A link was sent moments ago. Wait a minute before sending another.
studentError.EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Email sending is not set up in this environment.
studentError.EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED: The email could not be sent. Try again.
studentError.NOT_AUTHORISED: Your role cannot make this change.
studentError.INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields and try again.

learningAccess.title: Learning Access & Experiments
learningAccess.subtitle: Manage feature availability for students. Experiments are coming soon.
learningAccess.featureAccessHint: Choose which features are available to all eligible students.
learningAccess.footnote: When turned off globally, a feature can still be enabled for individual students in Student Management.
learningAccess.emergencyBody: By {name} on {date}. Reason: {reason}. This also blocks students with an Allow override. The global default and overrides are kept.
learningAccess.emergencyConfirmBody: Every student loses it on their next request, including those with an Allow override. Nothing else changes; Resume brings back the previous behaviour.
learningAccess.resumeBody: Access goes back to the global default and individual overrides.
learningAccess.confirmOnBody: About {count} eligible students on Global default will get it on their next request.
learningAccess.confirmOnDeny: {deny} students with Deny stay blocked; {allow} with Allow are unchanged.
learningAccess.confirmOffBody: Students on Global default lose it on their next request. {allow} students with Allow keep it.
learningAccess.readOnly: View only. Your role can see these settings but not change them.
learningAccess.saved: Settings saved. They apply on each student's next request.
learningAccess.experimentsBody: Explore A/B testing for AI Tutor strategies, banner placements and subscription pricing. Stay tuned!
